# FrameAssembly v3.0.0 (`.frasm`) — Prompt Injection Context

> **Usage**: Attach or inject this file into an LLM prompt when asking the assistant to generate, edit, review, or debug FrameAssembly `.frasm` (`text/vnd.frameassembly`) network packet capture code (v3.0.0, https://frameassembly.ai.studio/). For search engine indexing and discovery links, see `llms.txt`.

## 1. LLM Generation Contract (Follow Strictly)

1. Always emit **complete, standalone, compilable `.frasm` code**: `host` declarations, optional parameterized `flow(p1, p2, ...)` definitions, and **one** `compile { ... }` block at the end. Never output bare packet lines without `host` and `compile`.
2. Use `compile { a -> b ... }` inline statements for quick single-shot captures, and use parameterized `flow name(a, b) { ... }` whenever packets are reused across host pairs (e.g., IPv4 + IPv6 dual-stack) or represent multi-step protocols.
3. Follow **v3.0.0 strict-lowercase syntax**: every built-in keyword, protocol, modifier, and time unit (`ns`, `us`, `ms`, `s`, `m`) is strictly lowercase `[a-z0-9]+` with **zero underscores** (`_`) and **zero hyphens** (`-`), and there is **no `loop` keyword**.
4. Use only documented CLI invocations when showing terminal commands: `frameassembly file.frasm [out.pcap]`, `frameassembly show file.frasm`, `frameassembly reverse cap.pcap [out.frasm]`, `frameassembly help [cmd]`, `frameassembly version` (never `-o`, `--output`, or `frameassembly compile`).

## 2. Core v3.0.0 Language Rules, Stateful Engine & Anti-Hallucination Table

### Lexical, Structural & Type Rules
- **Extension & Disambiguation**: File extension is `.frasm` (renamed from `.fasm` in 3.0.0; code inside `.frasm` is distinct from x86 Flat Assembler and FPGA FASM). Comments use `// ...` only. Strings use double quotes `"..."` supporting `\"`, `\\`, `\n`, `\r`, `\t` (string contents preserve original case).
- **Host Declarations (`host`)**: `host <id> { [ip <ipv4_or_ipv6>] [mac <mac>] }`. At least one of `ip` or `mac` is required. MAC formats: `00:1a:2b:3c:4d:5e`, `00-1A-2B-3C-4D-5E`, or `001a.2b3c.4d5e`. User-defined `host`, `flow`, and parameter names allow letters, digits, `_`, and internal `-` (`[a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_]*(-[a-zA-Z0-9_]+)*`, e.g. `fw-dmz-01`, `core_sw`).
- **MAC-Only L2 Hosts vs. IP-Required Hosts**: MAC-only hosts (`host sw1 { mac 00:1c:73:00:00:01 }`) are valid **only** with the 8 pure Layer 2 protocols (`arp`, `vlan`, `qinq`, `lldp`, `stp`, `lacp`, `eapol`, `mpls`). All 73 L3/L4/L7 protocols require `ip` on both endpoints of that statement.
- **Dual-Stack Rule**: A `flow(a, b)` works polymorphically over IPv4 or IPv6 host pairs (`ttl` and `dscp` apply to both; `flowlabel` is ignored on IPv4). **Mixing IPv4 and IPv6 hosts in the same packet statement is a compile-time error.**
- **Validation Bounds**: `vlan` `<1..4094>`, `qinq` `<1..4094>`, `innervlan` `<1..4094>`, `pcp` `<0..7>`, `dei` `<0..1>`, `dscp` `<0..63>`, `ecn` `<0..3>`, `mpls` `<0..1048575>`, `exp`/`tc` `<0..7>`, `bos` `<0..1>`, `flowlabel` `<0..1048575>`, `hsrp hellotime` `<0..255>`. `payload "..."` and `hexpayload "..."` (even-length hex) are mutually exclusive on a single statement.

### Stateful Wire Engine (`1 Statement = 1 Frame`)
- **Direction (`->` / `<-`)**: `a -> b <mods> <proto> ...` sends from `a` to `b`. `a <- b <mods> <proto> ...` reverses wire direction (from `b` to `a`), automatically swapping source/dest IPs, MACs, and inherited L4 ports.
- **Timers (`wait`)**: Optional trailing `wait <u32><ns|us|ms|s|m>` sets pre-frame delay (default `10ms`; PCAPNG base timestamp `1_700_000_000_000_000_000` ns, `IfTsResol(9)`; `show` displays frame 1 at `0.000 ms`).
- **Automatic 4-Tuple TCP State**: TCP connections start at `seq = 1000`, `win = 64240`, default `srcport = 12345`. `syn` and `fin` advance sequence by `+1`; payload advances sequence by payload byte length. Any TCP-backed Layer 7 protocol emits `psh ack` on its well-known port and shares `seq`/`acknum` counters with raw `tcp` statements on the same 4-tuple unless explicitly overridden.
- **Port Inheritance & Dynamic L7 Dispatch**: `srcport`/`dstport` set on an opening packet are inherited (and flipped on `<-`) across subsequent packets in that flow. Built-in dynamic dispatch: `dhcp` (`68/67` v4 vs `546/547` v6), `mdns` (`224.0.0.251`/`ff02::fb` UDP `5353`), `ptp` (`319` Event vs `320` General), `radius` (`1812` Auth vs `1813` Accounting).
- **Automatic MAC Derivation Order**: (1) statement `srcmac`/`dstmac`, (2) IEEE 802.1D L2 control multicast (`lldp`/`stp`/`lacp`/`eapol`) or broadcast (`arp request`), (3) RFC 1112 IPv4 multicast (`01:00:5e:xx:xx:xx`) or RFC 2464 IPv6 multicast (`33:33:xx:xx:xx:xx`), (4) host `mac`, (5) direction-aware unicast defaults (`00:00:00:00:00:01` forward, `00:00:00:00:00:02` reverse).
- **Checksums & Crypto**: Automatically computes IPv4 header checksums, TCP/UDP/ICMPv6 pseudo-header checksums, VRRPv2/v3 checksums, SCTP Castagnoli `CRC-32c`, IEEE 1815 DNP3 per-chunk `CRC-16`, and RFC 3414/3826/7860 SNMPv3 USM key localization + AES-128-CFB/DES-CBC encryption + HMAC auth tags.

### Anti-Hallucination Guardrails (`❌ NEVER` vs `✅ ALWAYS`)

| Construct | ❌ NEVER WRITE | ✅ ALWAYS WRITE (v3.0.0 `.frasm`) |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Keyword Casing** | `HOST`, `FLOW`, `COMPILE`, `TCP`, `SYN`, `WAIT 5MS` | `host`, `flow`, `compile`, `tcp`, `syn`, `wait 5ms` |
| **Keyword `_` or `-`** | `echo_request`, `inner_vlan`, `client_hello`, `host_hdr`, `who-is` | `echorequest`, `innervlan`, `clienthello`, `hosthdr`, `whois` |
| **Comments** | `# comment`, `; comment`, or `/* block */` | `// single-line comment` |
| **Host Block** | `host c = { ipv4: "10.0.0.1", mask: 24 }`, `ipv6 ::1`, `host c {}` | `host c { ip 10.0.0.1 mac 00:11:22:33:44:55 }` or `host sw { mac 00:11:22:33:44:55 }` |
| **Flow Signature** | `flow web { from c to s send http }` | `flow web(c, s) { c -> s http get uri "/" }` |
| **Inter-Frame Delay** | `[+5ms] c -> s tcp ack` or standalone `wait 5ms` | `c -> s tcp ack wait 5ms` |
| **Ports & TCP Ack** | `sport 1234 dport 80 ack 100 sack_perm` | `srcport 1234 dstport 80 seq 1 acknum 100 sackperm` |
| **TCP Flags** | `flags [syn, ack]` or `flags="SA"` | `tcp syn ack` (`syn ack fin rst psh urg ece cwr`) |
| **Hop Limit & QoS** | `hop_limit 64`, `hoplimit 64`, or `tos 46` | `ttl 64 dscp 46 ecn 2` |
| **VLAN & QinQ** | `vlan 0`, `qinq 100 200`, or `qinq 100 inner_vlan 200` | `vlan 100 pcp 5 dei 0` or `qinq 100 innervlan 200` |
| **HTTP & RTSP Hdrs** | `http get host "a.com"` or `rtsp setup transport "..."` | `http get uri "/" hosthdr "a.com"` / `rtsp setup transporthdr "..."` |
| **BGP vs RIP Prefix** | `bgp update prefix 10.0.0.0/8` / `rip prefix "10.0.0.0/8"` | `bgp update prefix "10.0.0.0/8"` / `rip prefix 10.0.0.0` |
| **DHCP vs SNMP ID** | `dhcp discover txid 1` or `snmp2 get req_id 1` | `dhcp discover xid 1` / `snmp2 get reqid 1` |
| **IKEv2 & SNMPv3** | `ikev2 sa_init` or `snmp3 auth "sha256" "pw"` | `ikev2 sainit` (`createchildsa`\|`informational`) / `snmp3 auth sha256 "pw"` |
| **Compile & Loops** | `loop 3 { f(h1, h2) }`, omitted `compile`, or `compile { f }` | `compile { f(h1, h2) f(h1, h2) h1 -> h2 icmp }` |
| **CLI Invocation** | `-o out.pcap`, `--output`, or `compile` subcommand | `frameassembly demo.frasm out.pcap` / `frameassembly reverse out.pcap out.frasm` |

## 3. Universal Cross-Layer Modifiers (Allowed on Any Statement Before Protocol)

- **Layer 2 (`src/ast/l2/mod.rs`)**: `[srcmac <mac>] [dstmac <mac>] [ethertype <u16>] [vlan <1..4094> [pcp <0..7>] [dei <0|1>]] [qinq <1..4094> [innervlan <1..4094>] [pcp <0..7>] [dei <0|1>]] [mpls <0..1048575> [exp|tc <0..7>] [bos <0|1>] [mplsttl <u8>]]`
- **Layer 3 (`src/ast/l3/mod.rs`)**: `[ttl <0..255>] [dscp <0..63>] [ecn <0..3>] [flowlabel <0..1048575>] [ipid <u16>] [df] [mf] [fragoffset <0..8191>] [nextheader <u8>]`
- **Layer 4 (`src/ast/l4/mod.rs`)**: `[srcport <u16>] [dstport <u16>] [transport <tcp|udp>]` (default-TCP protocols switchable to UDP: `modbus`, `nfs`, `memcached`, `dnp3`, `ethernetip`; default-UDP protocols switchable to TCP: `dns`, `sip`, `syslog`, `kerberos`) `[seq <u32>] [acknum <u32>] [win|window <u16>] [urgent <u16>] [syn] [ack] [fin] [rst] [psh] [urg] [ece] [cwr] [mss <u16>] [wscale <u8>] [sackperm] [tsval <u32>] [tsecr <u32>]`
- **Payload & Timing**: `[payload "<escaped_utf8>" | hexpayload "<even_hex>"]` (mutually exclusive) `[wait <u32><ns|us|ms|s|m>]`

## 4. Complete 81-Protocol Syntax, Modifiers & Default Ports

Every protocol compiles with **zero mandatory sub-keywords** (emitting RFC-compliant wire defaults and ports). Combine any Layer 2/3/4 modifiers before `<protocol>` on the same statement.

### Layer 2 Switching & Data-Link (8 Protocols — MAC-only `host` allowed)

- **`arp`** (EtherType 0x0806): `arp [request | reply] [gratuitous] [sendermac <mac>] [senderip <ip>] [targetmac <mac>] [targetip <ip>]`
- **`vlan`** (EtherType 0x8100 (stackable L2 tag)): `vlan <vid> [pcp <0..7>] [dei <0|1>]`
- **`qinq`** (EtherType 0x88A8 + 0x8100 (double tag)): `qinq <outer_vid> [innervlan <inner_vid>]`
- **`lldp`** (EtherType 0x88CC, dst MAC 01:80:c2:00:00:0e): `lldp [chassisid "<str>"] [portid "<str>"] [ttl <u16>] [sysname "<str>"] [sysdesc "<str>"]`
- **`stp`** (802.3 LLC 0x424203, dst MAC 01:80:c2:00:00:00): `[stp | rstp] [rootid "<str>"] [bridgeid "<str>"] [portid <u16>] [cost <u32>] [maxage <u16>] [hellotime <u16>] [forwarddelay <u16>] [flags <u8>]`
- **`lacp`** (EtherType 0x8809, dst MAC 01:80:c2:00:00:02): `lacp [actorsys <mac>] [actorkey <u16>] [actorport <u16>] [actorstate <u8>] [partnersys <mac>] [partnerkey <u16>] [partnerport <u16>] [partnerstate <u8>]`
- **`eapol`** (EtherType 0x888E, dst MAC 01:80:c2:00:00:03): `eapol [version <u8>] [type <eappacket | start | logoff | key>] [eapcode <u8>] [eapid <u8>] [eapmethod <u8>] [identity "<str>"]`
- **`mpls`** (EtherType 0x8847 (stackable MPLS shim)): `mpls <label> [exp <0..7>] [bos <0|1>] [mplsttl <u8>]`

### Layer 3 Control, Tunneling, VPN, Routing & FHRP (20 Protocols)

- **`icmp`** (IPv4 Proto 1 / IPv6 NextHeader 58): `icmp [echorequest | echoreply | destunreach | timeexceeded | redirect] [type <u8>] [code <u8>] [id <u16>] [seq <u16>] [gateway <ipv4>]`
- **`ndp`** (IPv6 ICMPv6 NH 58, default ttl 255): `ndp [routersolicit | routeradvert | neighborsolicit | neighboradvert | redirect] [target <ipv6>] [slla <mac>] [tlla <mac>] [routerlifetime <u16>]`
- **`igmp`** (IPv4 Proto 2): `igmp [query | report | leave] [group <ipv4>] [maxresp <u8>] [v1 | v2 | v3]`
- **`mld`** (IPv6 ICMPv6 NH 58): `mld [query | report | done] [multicastaddr <ipv6>] [maxrespdelay <u16>]`
- **`gre`** (IP Proto 47): `gre [grekey <u32>] [greseq <u32>] [greproto <u16>] [checksum]`
- **`vxlan`** (UDP 4789): `vxlan [vni <0..16777215>]`
- **`geneve`** (UDP 6081): `geneve [vni <u24>] [optclass <u16>] [opttype <u8>] [protocoltype <u16>]`
- **`ipsec`** (IP Proto 50 (ESP)): `ipsec [spi <u32>] [seq <u32>] [iv "<hex>"] [icv "<hex>"] [nextheader <u8>]`
- **`esp`** (IP Proto 50 (alias for ipsec)): `esp [spi <u32>] [seq <u32>] [iv "<hex>"] [icv "<hex>"] [nextheader <u8>]`
- **`ah`** (IP Proto 51): `ah [spi <u32>] [seq <u32>] [icv "<hex>"] [nextheader <u8>]`
- **`ikev2`** (UDP 500): `ikev2 [exchange <sainit|auth|createchildsa|informational>] [initiatorspi <u64>] [responderspi <u64>] [msgid <u32>] [flags <u8>] [nextheader <u8>]`
- **`wireguard`** (UDP 51820): `wireguard [type <initiation|response|cookie|data> | initiation | cookie | data] [sender <u32>] [receiver <u32>] [counter <u64>]`
- **`ospf`** (IP Proto 89): `ospf [hello | dbd | lsr | lsu | lsack] [routerid <ipv4>] [areaid <u32>] [hellointerval <u16>] [deadinterval <u32>] [priority <u8>]`
- **`bgp`** (TCP 179): `bgp [open | update | notification | keepalive] [asn <u32>] [holdtime <u16>] [bgpid <ipv4>] [prefix "<cidr>"] [nexthop <ip>]`
- **`rip`** (UDP 520 (v4) / UDP 521 (RIPng v6)): `rip [request | response] [prefix <ip>] [metric <1..16>] [nexthop <ip>] [tag <u16>]`
- **`pim`** (IP Proto 103): `pim [hello | joinprune | register] [holdtime <u16>] [drpriority <u32>] [group <ip>] [source <ip>] [rp <ip>]`
- **`vrrp`** (IP Proto 112, default ttl 255): `vrrp [vrid <1..255>] [priority <0..255>] [advint <u16>] [vip <ip>] [version <2|3>]`
- **`hsrp`** (UDP 1985 (v1) / UDP 2029 (v2/v6)): `hsrp [group <u8>] [priority <u8>] [state <u8>] [hellotime <u8>] [holdtime <u8>] [auth "<str>"] [vip <ip>]`
- **`bfd`** (UDP 3784): `bfd [state <0..3>] [diag <0..31>] [mydisc <u32>] [yourdisc <u32>] [mintx <u32>] [minrx <u32>] [mult <u8>]`
- **`openflow`** (TCP 6653): `openflow [hello | echoreq | echoreply | featuresreq | featuresreply | packetin | packetout | flowmod] [version <u8>] [xid <u32>] [dpid <u64>] [tableid <u8>] [priority <u16>]`

### Layer 4 Transports (3 Protocols)

- **`tcp`** (IP Proto 6, default dstport 80 / srcport 12345): `tcp [syn] [ack] [fin] [rst] [psh] [urg] [ece] [cwr] [srcport <u16>] [dstport <u16>] [seq <u32>] [acknum <u32>] [win <u16>] [urgent <u16>] [mss <u16>] [wscale <u8>] [sackperm] [tsval <u32>] [tsecr <u32>]`
- **`udp`** (IP Proto 17, default dstport 80 / srcport 12345): `udp [srcport <u16>] [dstport <u16>] [payload "<str>" | hexpayload "<hex>"]`
- **`sctp`** (IP Proto 132, Castagnoli CRC-32c LE): `sctp [chunk <data|init|initack|sack|heartbeat|heartbeatack|abort|shutdown|shutdownack|cookieecho|cookieack>] [vtag <u32>] [stream <u16>] [ssn <u16>] [ppid <u32>]`

### Layer 7 SNMP (3 Protocols)

- **`snmp1`** (UDP 162 (trap) / UDP 161 (get/getnext/set/response)): `snmp1 [trap | get | getnext | set | response] [community <str>] [enterprise <oid>] [agentip <ip>] [gentrap <u32>] [spectrap <u32>] [sysuptime <u32>] [reqid <u32>] [varbind <oid> <val>...]`
- **`snmp2`** (UDP 162 (trap/inform) / UDP 161 (get/getnext/getbulk/set/response)): `snmp2 [trap | inform | get | getnext | getbulk | set | response] [community <str>] [reqid <u32>] [nonrepeaters <u32>] [maxrepetitions <u32>] [sysuptime <u32>] [oid <oid>] [varbind <oid> <val>...]`
- **`snmp3`** (UDP 162 (trap/inform/report) / UDP 161 (polls), RFC 3414/3826/7860 USM): `snmp3 [trap | inform | get | getnext | getbulk | set | response] [user <str>] [engineid <hex>] [engineboots <u32>] [enginetime <u32>] [contextname <str>] [auth <alg> <pass>] [priv <alg> <pass>] [reqid <u32>] [nonrepeaters <u32>] [maxrepetitions <u32>] [sysuptime <u32>] [oid <oid>] [varbind <oid> <val>...]`
- **`varbind` values** (shared across `snmp1`/`snmp2`/`snmp3`, also accepts bare `null` alias): `varbind <oid> <nullval | string <str> | int <i32> | timeticks <u32> | ipval <ip> | oidval <oid> | counter32 <u32> | gauge32 <u32> | counter64 <u64>>`

### Layer 7 Infrastructure, Time, AAA & Telemetry (11 Protocols)

- **`dns`** (UDP 53 (or `transport tcp` -> TCP 53)): `dns [query | response] [txid <u16>] [qname <str>] [qtype <str>] [rdata <str>] [rcode <u8>] [ansttl <u32>] [transport tcp]`
- **`mdns`** (UDP 5353, multicast 224.0.0.251 / ff02::fb): `mdns [query | response] [txid <u16>] [qname <str>] [qtype <str>] [rdata <str>] [rcode <u8>] [ansttl <u32>]`
- **`dhcp`** (UDP 68/67 (v4) / UDP 546/547 (DHCPv6)): `dhcp [discover | offer | request | ack | release | solicit | advertise | reply] [xid <u32>] [ciaddr <ip>] [yiaddr <ip>] [siaddr <ip>] [chaddr <mac>] [hostname <str>] [dnsserver <ip>] [router <ip>] [subnetmask <ip>] [leasetime <u32>]`
- **`ntp`** (UDP 123): `ntp [li <u8>] [vn <u8>] [mode <u8>] [stratum <u8>] [poll <u8>] [precision <i8>] [refid <str>] [txtimestamp <u64>]`
- **`ptp`** (UDP 319 (sync/delayreq) / UDP 320 (followup/delayresp/announce)): `ptp [sync | delayreq | followup | delayresp | announce | msgtype <str>] [domain <u8>] [seqid <u16>] [clockid <str>]`
- **`radius`** (UDP 1812 (access*) / UDP 1813 (accounting*)): `radius [accessrequest | accessaccept | accessreject | accesschallenge | accountingrequest | accountingresponse | code <str>] [id <u8>] [user <str>] [nasip <ip>] [servicetype <u32>] [framedip <ip>]`
- **`tacacs`** (TCP 49): `tacacs [type authen | type author | type acct | authen | author | acct] [seq <u8>] [flags <u8>] [sessionid <u32>] [user <str>] [data <str>] [payload <str>]`
- **`syslog`** (UDP 514 (or `transport tcp` -> TCP 514)): `syslog [facility <u8>] [severity <u8>] [pri <u8>] [hostname <str>] [app <str>] [procid <str>] [msgid <str>] [msg <str>] [transport tcp]`
- **`netflow`** (UDP 2055): `netflow [srcip <ip>] [dstip <ip>] [srcport <u16>] [dstport <u16>] [proto <u8>] [packets <u32>] [octets <u32>]`
- **`ipfix`** (UDP 4739): `ipfix [domainid <u32>] [srcip <ip>] [dstip <ip>] [srcport <u16>] [dstport <u16>] [proto <u8>] [packets <u32>] [octets <u32>]`
- **`sflow`** (UDP 6343): `sflow [agentip <ip>] [subagentid <u32>] [seq <u32>] [uptime <u32>] [samples <u32>]`

### Layer 7 Web, Cloud, TLS, VoIP & Remote Access (16 Protocols)

- **`http`** (TCP 80): `http [method <str>] [uri <str>] [version <str>] [hosthdr <str>] [useragent <str>] [contenttype <str>] [status <u16>] [reason <str>] [header <key> <val>] [body <str>]`
- **`http2`** (TCP 443): `http2 [preface | settings | headers | data | windowupdate | ping | goaway] [streamid <u32>]`
- **`grpc`** (TCP 50051): `grpc [service <str>] [method <str>] [grpcstatus <u32>]`
- **`websocket`** (TCP 80): `websocket [opcode <str>] [finbit <u8>] [maskkey <u32>] [payload <str>]`
- **`tls`** (TCP 443): `tls [clienthello | serverhello | certificate | finished | appdata | alert] [recordversion <u16>] [handshakeversion <u16>] [sni <str>] [ciphersuite <u16>] [alpn <str>]`
- **`quic`** (UDP 443): `quic [initial | zerortt | handshake | retry | short] [version <u32>] [dcid <u64>] [scid <u64>] [token <str>] [pktnum <u32>]`
- **`ssh`** (TCP 22): `ssh [banner <str>] [kexinit] [newkeys] [msgcode <u8>] [cookie <str>] [payload <str>]`
- **`telnet`** (TCP 23): `telnet [do <u8>] [dont <u8>] [will <u8>] [wont <u8>] [option <u8>] [data <str>] [payload <str>]`
- **`tftp`** (UDP 69): `tftp [rrq | wrq | data | ack | error] [filename <str>] [mode <str>] [block <u16>] [errcode <u16>] [errmsg <str>]`
- **`ftp`** (TCP 21): `ftp [cmd <str>] [arg <str>] [code <u16>] [reply <str>]`
- **`whois`** (TCP 43): `whois [query | response] [domain <str>] [registrar <str>]`
- **`sip`** (UDP 5060 (or `transport tcp` -> TCP 5060)): `sip [invite | bye | cancel | method <str>] [uri <str>] [status <u16>] [reason <str>] [from <str>] [to <str>] [callid <str>] [cseq <u32>] [via <str>] [contact <str>] [contenttype <str>] [body <str>] [transport tcp]`
- **`rtp`** (UDP 5004): `rtp [pt <u8>] [seq <u16>] [timestamp <u32>] [ssrc <u32>] [marker <u8>]`
- **`rtsp`** (TCP 554): `rtsp [options | method <str>] [uri <str>] [status <u16>] [cseq <u32>] [transporthdr <str>] [session <str>]`
- **`stun`** (UDP 3478): `stun [bindingrequest | bindingresponse | bindingerror] [txid <u32>] [xormappedaddr <ip>] [software <str>]`
- **`ssdp`** (UDP 1900): `ssdp [msearch | notify] [hosthdr <str>] [man <str>] [mx <u8>] [st <str>] [nt <str>] [nts <str>] [usn <str>] [location <str>]`

### Layer 7 Mail, Identity, Storage, Databases & Brokers (14 Protocols)

- **`smtp`** (TCP 25): `smtp [ehlo [str]] [helo [str]] [mailfrom <str>] [rcptto <str>] [data] [quit] [cmd <str>] [param <str>] [code <u16>] [reply <str>] [body <str>]`
- **`imap`** (TCP 143): `imap [tag <str>] [cmd <str>] [arg <str>] [status <str>] [response <str>]`
- **`pop3`** (TCP 110): `pop3 [cmd <str>] [arg <str>] [ok] [err] [response <str>]`
- **`kerberos`** (UDP 88 (or `transport tcp` -> TCP 88)): `kerberos [asreq | asrep | tgsreq | tgsrep | krberror] [realm <str>] [cname <str>] [sname <str>] [etype <i32>]`
- **`ldap`** (TCP 389): `ldap [msgid <i32>] [bindreq | bindres | searchreq | searchentry | searchdone | unbindreq] [basedn <str>] [filter <str>] [resultcode <u32>]`
- **`smb`** (TCP 445): `smb [command <str>] [status <u32>] [treeid <u32>] [sessionid <u64>] [msgid <u64>] [share <str>] [filename <str>]`
- **`nfs`** (TCP 2049 (or `transport udp` -> UDP 2049)): `nfs [vers <u32>] [proc <str>] [tag <str>] [path <str>] [xid <u32>]`
- **`redis`** (TCP 6379): `redis [cmd <str>] [args <str>] [replytype <str>] [value <str>]`
- **`memcached`** (TCP 11211 (or `transport udp` -> UDP 11211)): `memcached [cmd <str>] [key <str>] [value <str>] [flags <u32>] [exptime <u32>] [opcode <u8>] [opaque <u32>] [cas <u64>]`
- **`mysql`** (TCP 3306): `mysql [greeting | login | query | ok | err | eof] [serverversion <str>] [user <str>] [db <str>] [sql <str>] [errcode <u16>]`
- **`postgres`** (TCP 5432): `postgres [startup | query | authok | commandcomplete | readyforquery | errorresponse] [user <str>] [db <str>] [sql <str>]`
- **`mqtt`** (TCP 1883): `mqtt [connect | connack | publish | puback | subscribe | suback | pingreq | pingresp | disconnect | pkttype <str>] [clientid <str>] [topic <str>] [qos <u8>] [retain] [pktid <u16>] [keepalive <u16>] [returncode <u8>]`
- **`coap`** (UDP 5683): `coap [con | non | ack | rst] [code <str>] [msgid <u16>] [token <u32>] [uripath <str>] [contentformat <u16>]`
- **`amqp`** (TCP 5672): `amqp [protocolheader | connectionstart | channelopen | basicpublish | basicdeliver | heartbeat] [channel <u16>] [exchange <str>] [routingkey <str>]`

### Layer 7 Industrial Control Systems & SCADA/OT (6 Protocols)

- **`modbus`** (TCP 502 (or `transport udp` -> UDP 502)): `modbus [txid <u16>] [protoid <u16>] [unitid <u8>] [func <str>] [addr <u16>] [count <u16>] [value <u16>] [isresponse]`
- **`bacnet`** (UDP 47808): `bacnet [whois | iam | readproperty | writeproperty] [invokeid <u8>] [objecttype <u16>] [objectinstance <u32>] [propertyid <u32>] [value <u32>]`
- **`dnp3`** (TCP 20000 (or `transport udp` -> UDP 20000), CRC-16): `dnp3 [read | write | select | operate | directoperate | confirm | response | unsolicitedresponse | func <str>] [src <u16>] [dst <u16>] [group <u8>] [variation <u8>] [crc <u16>]`
- **`s7comm`** (TCP 102): `s7comm [rosctr <str>] [pduref <u16>] [func <str>] [area <u8>] [dbnum <u16>] [offset <u32>] [count <u16>]`
- **`ethernetip`** (TCP 44818 (or `transport udp` -> UDP 44818)): `ethernetip [nop | listidentity | registersession | sendrrdata | sendunitdata | cmd <str>] [sessionhandle <u32>] [status <u32>] [context <u64>] [cipservice <u8>] [cipclass <u16>] [cipinstance <u16>] [cipattr <u16>]`
- **`opcua`** (TCP 4840): `opcua [msgtype <str>] [chunktype <str>] [securechannelid <u32>] [tokenid <u32>] [seqnum <u32>] [reqid <u32>] [endpointurl <str>] [nodeid <str>]`

## 5. Canonical Compilable `.frasm` Reference Examples

Every block below compiles standalone under FrameAssembly v3.0.0 (`host` + optional `flow` + `compile`).

### Inline L2/L3 Ping, TCP Handshake, Stacked QoS & Dual-Stack Reuse (`docs/01_getting_started.md`)

```frameassembly
// 1. Declare the endpoints
host workstation { ip 192.168.10.50 mac 00:1a:2b:3c:4d:50 }
host gateway     { ip 192.168.10.1  mac 00:1a:2b:3c:4d:01 }

// 2. Describe the packet exchange (1 line = 1 wire frame)
flow ping_check(c, gw) {
    c -> gw icmp echorequest id 100 seq 1 payload "ping-1"
    c <- gw icmp echoreply   id 100 seq 1 payload "ping-1" wait 2ms
    c -> gw icmp echorequest id 100 seq 2 payload "ping-2" wait 10ms
    c <- gw icmp echoreply   id 100 seq 2 payload "ping-2" wait 2ms
}

// 3. Build the capture
compile { ping_check(workstation, gateway) }
```

```frameassembly
host linux_srv  { ip 10.0.0.10 mac 00:1a:2b:3c:4d:5e }
host windows_pc { ip 10.0.0.20 mac 00-1A-2B-3C-4D-5F }
host cisco_sw   { ip 10.0.0.1  mac 001a.2b3c.4d01 }
host core_rtr   { ip 10.0.0.254 }
host ospf_mcast { ip 224.0.0.5 }

flow mac_and_multicast_demo(srv, pc, sw, rtr, mcast) {
    pc  -> sw arp request sendermac 00-1A-2B-3C-4D-5F senderip 10.0.0.20 targetip 10.0.0.1 wait 1ms
    pc  <- sw arp reply   sendermac 001a.2b3c.4d01    senderip 10.0.0.1  targetmac 00-1A-2B-3C-4D-5F targetip 10.0.0.20 wait 2ms
    srv -> pc icmp echorequest id 1 seq 1 payload "all-mac-formats-work" wait 2ms

    // ospf_mcast has no MAC, so 01:00:5e:00:00:05 is derived automatically
    rtr -> mcast ttl 1 ospf hello routerid 10.0.0.254 areaid 0 hellointerval 10 deadinterval 40
}

compile { mac_and_multicast_demo(linux_srv, windows_pc, cisco_sw, core_rtr, ospf_mcast) }
```

```frameassembly
host app_client { ip 10.20.1.50 }
host web_server { ip 10.20.1.80 }

flow http_health_check(c, s) {
    c -> s tcp syn srcport 52100 dstport 80 win 65535 mss 1460 wscale 7 sackperm wait 1ms
    c <- s tcp syn ack win 65535 mss 1460 wscale 7 sackperm wait 1ms
    c -> s tcp ack wait 1ms

    c -> s http get uri "/api/v1/status" hosthdr "api.internal" useragent "NOC-Probe/1.0" wait 5ms
    c <- s http status 200 reason "OK" contenttype "application/json" body "{\"healthy\":true}" wait 2ms

    c -> s tcp fin ack wait 1ms
    c <- s tcp fin ack wait 1ms
    c -> s tcp ack
}

compile { http_health_check(app_client, web_server) }
```

```frameassembly
host sensor_v4    { ip 10.50.0.10 }
host collector_v4 { ip 10.50.0.100 }
host sensor_v6    { ip 2001:db8:50::10 }
host collector_v6 { ip 2001:db8:50::100 }

flow heartbeat_and_log(node, col) {
    node -> col vlan 50 dscp 16 ttl 64 flowlabel 0x1a2b3 icmp echorequest id 90 seq 1 payload "HB" wait 2ms
    node <- col vlan 50 dscp 16 ttl 64 flowlabel 0x1a2b3 icmp echoreply   id 90 seq 1 payload "HB" wait 5ms
    node -> col vlan 50 dscp 16 ttl 64 flowlabel 0x1a2b3 syslog facility 16 severity 6 hostname "edge-01" app "healthd" msg "Link OK" wait 10ms
}

compile {
    heartbeat_and_log(sensor_v4, collector_v4)
    heartbeat_and_log(sensor_v6, collector_v6)
    heartbeat_and_log(sensor_v4, collector_v4)
}
```

### MAC Overrides, ARP/GARP, QinQ + MPLS Stacks, STP/LACP & 802.1X EAPOL (`docs/03_l2_protocols.md`)

```frameassembly
host sensor_a { ip 10.10.1.10 mac 00:1b:21:aa:bb:01 }
host sensor_b { ip 10.10.1.20 mac 00:1b:21:aa:bb:02 }

flow custom_ethernet_framing(a, b) {
    // Normal unicast UDP frame using the MACs from the host blocks
    a -> b udp srcport 40000 dstport 40000 payload "NORMAL_UNICAST" wait 1ms

    // Spoofed source MAC, broadcast destination, EtherType 0x88b5 (IEEE local experimental)
    a -> b udp srcport 40000 dstport 40000 srcmac de:ad:be:ef:00:01 dstmac ff:ff:ff:ff:ff:ff ethertype 0x88b5 payload "CUSTOM_L2_ETHERTYPE"
}

compile {
    custom_ethernet_framing(sensor_a, sensor_b)
}
```

```frameassembly
host sw1 { mac 00:1c:73:00:00:01 }
host sw2 { mac 00:1c:73:00:00:02 }

compile {
    sw1 -> sw2 lldp chassisid "00:1c:73:00:00:01" portid "Ethernet1/1" ttl 120 sysname "spine-01" wait 2ms
    sw1 <- sw2 stp rstp rootid "4096/00:1c:73:00:00:02" bridgeid "4096/00:1c:73:00:00:02" portid 0x8001 cost 0 flags 0x3c wait 2ms
    sw1 -> sw2 lacp actorsys 00:1c:73:00:00:01 actorkey 10 actorport 1 actorstate 0x3f partnersys 00:1c:73:00:00:02 partnerkey 10 partnerport 1 partnerstate 0x3f
}
```

```frameassembly
host fw_standby { ip 192.168.10.2   mac 00:50:56:fe:00:02 }
host lan_bcast  { ip 192.168.10.255 mac ff:ff:ff:ff:ff:ff }

flow vip_takeover(sec, bcast) {
    // Standby claims 192.168.10.1 with its own MAC. DAI should have an opinion about this.
    sec -> bcast arp reply gratuitous sendermac 00:50:56:fe:00:02 senderip 192.168.10.1 targetmac ff:ff:ff:ff:ff:ff targetip 192.168.10.1
}

compile { vip_takeover(fw_standby, lan_bcast) }
```

```frameassembly
host tor_sw_a { ip 172.16.10.1 mac 00:1c:73:10:00:01 }
host tor_sw_b { ip 172.16.10.2 mac 00:1c:73:10:00:02 }

flow trunk_cos_mix(a, b) {
    // VLAN 10: voice, PCP 5, DSCP 46 (EF)
    a -> b vlan 10 pcp 5 dei 0 dscp 46 rtp seq 101 timestamp 16000 ssrc 0x11223344 payload "G711_PCMU_FRAME" wait 1ms

    // VLAN 20: RoCEv2 lossless queue, PCP 3, DSCP 26 (AF31)
    a -> b vlan 20 pcp 3 dei 0 dscp 26 udp srcport 51000 dstport 4791 payload "RDMA_WRITE_ONLY" wait 1ms

    // VLAN 99: backup traffic marked drop-eligible, PCP 1, DEI 1, DSCP 8 (CS1)
    a -> b vlan 99 pcp 1 dei 1 dscp 8 tcp psh ack srcport 49152 dstport 873 payload "RSYNC_SNAPSHOT_CHUNK"
}

compile { trunk_cos_mix(tor_sw_a, tor_sw_b) }
```

```frameassembly
host core_root { ip 10.0.1.1  mac 00:1c:73:00:00:01 }
host dist_sw   { ip 10.0.1.2  mac 00:1c:73:00:00:02 }
host rogue_sw  { ip 10.0.1.99 mac 00:e0:4c:99:99:99 }

flow bpduguard_test(root, dist, rogue) {
    // Legitimate root (priority 4096) sends a steady-state designated BPDU
    root -> dist stp rstp rootid "4096/00:1c:73:00:00:01" bridgeid "4096/00:1c:73:00:00:01" portid 0x8001 cost 0 maxage 20 hellotime 2 forwarddelay 15 flags 0x3c wait 5ms

    // Rogue switch injects a priority 0 superior BPDU. BPDU Guard should err-disable the port.
    rogue -> dist stp rstp rootid "0/00:e0:4c:99:99:99" bridgeid "0/00:e0:4c:99:99:99" portid 0x8001 cost 0 flags 0x3c
}

compile { bpduguard_test(core_root, dist_sw, rogue_sw) }
```

```frameassembly
host tor_sw   { ip 10.0.2.1 mac 00:1c:73:11:22:33 }
host linux_hv { ip 10.0.2.2 mac 00:50:56:88:99:aa }

flow lacp_bond_bringup(sw, hv) {
    // Unbundled and defaulted (0x47), partner unknown
    sw -> hv lacp actorsys 00:1c:73:11:22:33 actorkey 10 actorport 1 actorstate 0x47 partnersys 00:00:00:00:00:00 partnerkey 0 partnerport 0 partnerstate 0x00 wait 2ms

    // Linux bond0 answers, in sync (0x0f)
    sw <- hv lacp actorsys 00:50:56:88:99:aa actorkey 10 actorport 1 actorstate 0x0f partnersys 00:1c:73:11:22:33 partnerkey 10 partnerport 1 partnerstate 0x07 wait 2ms

    // Both sides reach Collecting + Distributing (0x3f)
    sw -> hv lacp actorsys 00:1c:73:11:22:33 actorkey 10 actorport 1 actorstate 0x3f partnersys 00:50:56:88:99:aa partnerkey 10 partnerport 1 partnerstate 0x3f
}

compile { lacp_bond_bringup(tor_sw, linux_hv) }
```

### ICMP/NDP/IGMP/MLD, BGP/OSPF/VRRP/BFD, GRE/VXLAN/GENEVE, IPsec/IKEv2/WireGuard (`docs/04_l3_protocols.md`)

```frameassembly
host app_srv    { ip 10.88.1.10 mac 00:50:56:88:01:0a }
host wan_pri_gw { ip 10.88.1.2  mac 00:00:5e:00:01:58 }

flow pmtud_blackhole(srv, gw) {
    // Oversized DF ping hits the 1400-byte GRE limit; the router answers ICMP Type 3 Code 4
    srv -> gw df ttl 64 icmp echorequest id 4410 seq 1 payload "oversized_1472_byte_wan_probe" wait 2ms
    srv <- gw ttl 64 icmp destunreach code 4 payload "mtu_1400_exceeded_on_gre0"
}

compile { pmtud_blackhole(app_srv, wan_pri_gw) }
```

```frameassembly
host edge_rtr { ip 198.51.100.2 mac 00:1c:73:64:00:02 }
host isp_pe   { ip 198.51.100.1 mac 00:1c:73:64:00:01 }

flow ospf_p2p_sync(ce, pe) {
    ce -> pe dscp 48 ttl 1 ospf hello routerid 10.0.0.2 areaid 0 hellointerval 1 deadinterval 4 priority 0 wait 2ms
    ce <- pe dscp 48 ttl 1 ospf dbd   routerid 10.0.0.1 areaid 0 wait 2ms
    ce -> pe dscp 48 ttl 1 ospf lsr   routerid 10.0.0.2 areaid 0 wait 2ms
    ce <- pe dscp 48 ttl 1 ospf lsu   routerid 10.0.0.1 areaid 0 payload "router_lsa_seq_0x80000001" wait 2ms
    ce -> pe dscp 48 ttl 1 ospf lsack routerid 10.0.0.2 areaid 0 wait 5ms
}

compile { ospf_p2p_sync(edge_rtr, isp_pe) }
```

```frameassembly
host wan_pri_gw { ip 10.88.1.2 mac 00:00:5e:00:01:58 }
host wan_sec_gw { ip 10.88.1.3 mac 00:1c:73:88:01:03 }

flow gateway_failover(pri, sec) {
    // Primary drops from 130 to 80 after its tracked uplink fails; backup (100) takes over
    pri -> sec dscp 48 ttl 255 vrrp vrid 88 priority 80  advint 20 vip 10.88.1.1 version 3 wait 5ms
    pri <- sec dscp 48 ttl 255 vrrp vrid 88 priority 100 advint 20 vip 10.88.1.1 version 3 wait 5ms

    // HSRP equivalent: Active state (16) with hellotime 3 and holdtime 10
    pri -> sec ttl 1 hsrp group 10 priority 110 state 16 vip 10.88.1.1 hellotime 3 holdtime 10 wait 5ms

    // RIP poison reverse: metric 16 means unreachable
    pri -> sec ttl 1 rip response prefix 10.10.0.0 metric 16 tag 100
}

compile { gateway_failover(wan_pri_gw, wan_sec_gw) }
```

```frameassembly
host compute_nve { ip 10.244.0.11 mac 00:16:3e:60:81:0b }
host inspect_nve { ip 10.244.0.50 mac 02:a1:b2:60:81:32 }

flow cloud_overlay_inspection(nve, fw) {
    // Cilium eBPF frame (optclass 267, Transparent Ethernet Bridging 0x6558)
    nve -> fw df dscp 18 ttl 64 geneve vni 2 optclass 267 opttype 1 protocoltype 0x6558 srcport 51234 dstport 6081 payload "CILIUM_ID_42105_HTTP_GET" wait 2ms

    // AWS GWLB appliance hairpin (optclass 264, routed IPv4 0x0800)
    nve -> fw df ttl 64 geneve vni 1 optclass 264 opttype 1 protocoltype 0x0800 srcport 49800 dstport 6081 payload "AWS_GWLBE_FLOW_COOKIE_IN" wait 1ms
    nve <- fw df ttl 64 geneve vni 1 optclass 264 opttype 1 protocoltype 0x0800 srcport 49800 dstport 6081 payload "AWS_GWLBE_FLOW_COOKIE_OK"
}

compile { cloud_overlay_inspection(compute_nve, inspect_nve) }
```

```frameassembly
host roaming_cli { ip 198.51.100.88 mac 00:1b:21:51:82:58 }
host vpn_headend { ip 203.0.113.1   mac 00:1b:21:51:82:01 }

flow ikev2_nat_float(cli, gw) {
    cli -> gw dscp 48 ikev2 sainit initiatorspi 111222333 responderspi 0 msgid 0 flags 8 nextpayload 33 srcport 500 dstport 500 wait 5ms
    cli <- gw dscp 48 ikev2 sainit initiatorspi 111222333 responderspi 444555666 msgid 0 flags 32 nextpayload 33 srcport 500 dstport 500 wait 5ms
    cli -> gw dscp 48 ikev2 informational initiatorspi 111222333 responderspi 444555666 msgid 1 flags 8 nextpayload 46 srcport 4500 dstport 4500
}

compile { ikev2_nat_float(roaming_cli, vpn_headend) }
```

```frameassembly
host roaming_cli { ip 198.51.100.88 mac 00:1b:21:51:82:58 }
host vpn_headend { ip 203.0.113.1   mac 00:1b:21:51:82:01 }

flow wireguard_cookie_retry(cli, gw) {
    cli -> gw df wireguard initiation sender 44301 srcport 54321 dstport 443 wait 3ms
    cli <- gw df wireguard cookie receiver 44301 srcport 443 dstport 54321 wait 3ms
    cli -> gw df wireguard initiation sender 44302 srcport 54321 dstport 443 wait 3ms
    cli <- gw df wireguard response sender 44303 receiver 44302 srcport 443 dstport 54321 wait 3ms
    cli -> gw df wireguard data receiver 44303 counter 0 srcport 54321 dstport 443 payload "CHACHA20_FIRST_PKT"
}

compile { wireguard_cookie_retry(roaming_cli, vpn_headend) }
```

### Stateful TCP Options, ZeroWindow/Scans, UDP Burst & SCTP Multi-Chunk (`docs/05_l4_transports.md`)

```frameassembly
host app_node { ip 10.20.1.10 mac 00:1b:21:aa:00:0a }
host db_srv   { ip 10.20.1.54 mac 00:1b:21:aa:00:36 }

flow tcp_session(c, s) {
    // Ports set once on the SYN. Replies flip them; seq and acknum are tracked automatically.
    c -> s tcp syn srcport 52400 dstport 5432 win 64240 mss 1460 wscale 7 sackperm wait 1ms
    c <- s tcp syn ack win 65535 mss 1460 wscale 7 sackperm wait 1ms
    c -> s tcp ack wait 1ms
    c -> s tcp psh ack payload "SELECT 1;" wait 2ms
    c <- s tcp psh ack payload "ROW 1" wait 2ms
    c -> s tcp fin ack wait 1ms
    c <- s tcp fin ack wait 1ms
    c -> s tcp ack
}

compile { tcp_session(app_node, db_srv) }
```

```frameassembly
host sender   { ip 10.20.0.10 mac 00:1b:21:aa:00:01 }
host receiver { ip 10.20.0.20 mac 00:1b:21:aa:00:02 }

flow tcp_dupack(tx, rx) {
    tx -> rx tcp syn srcport 42000 dstport 9100 seq 1000 win 64240 wait 1ms
    tx <- rx tcp syn ack seq 5000 acknum 1001 win 65535 wait 1ms
    tx -> rx tcp ack seq 1001 acknum 5001 win 64240 wait 1ms

    tx -> rx tcp psh ack seq 1001 acknum 5001 win 64240 payload "SEG_000001_" wait 1ms
    tx <- rx tcp ack seq 5001 acknum 1012 win 65535 wait 1ms
    tx -> rx tcp psh ack seq 1022 acknum 5001 win 64240 payload "SEG_000003" wait 2ms
    tx <- rx tcp ack seq 5001 acknum 1012 win 65535 wait 1ms
    tx -> rx tcp psh ack seq 1012 acknum 5001 win 64240 payload "SEG_000002" wait 2ms
    tx <- rx tcp ack seq 5001 acknum 1032 win 65535
}

compile { tcp_dupack(sender, receiver) }
```

```frameassembly
host workstation { ip 10.88.1.10 mac 00:50:56:88:01:0a }
host hop1_rtr    { ip 10.88.1.1  mac 00:1c:73:88:01:01 }
host target_srv  { ip 10.88.2.50 mac 00:50:56:88:02:32 }
host lan_bcast   { ip 10.88.1.255 mac ff:ff:ff:ff:ff:ff }

flow udp_diagnostics(src, rtr, dst, bcast) {
    // TTL 1 expires at the first hop; TTL 2 reaches the target and draws Port Unreachable
    src -> rtr ttl 1 udp srcport 54321 dstport 33434 payload "paris_probe_hop1" wait 1ms
    src <- rtr icmp timeexceeded code 0 wait 2ms
    src -> dst ttl 2 udp srcport 54321 dstport 33435 payload "paris_probe_hop2" wait 1ms
    src <- dst icmp destunreach code 3 wait 5ms

    // Two IPv4 fragments sharing IPID 4242
    src -> dst ipid 4242 mf fragoffset 0 udp srcport 51000 dstport 8125 payload "statsd.batch.part_a:1|c" wait 500us
    src -> dst ipid 4242 fragoffset 185 udp srcport 51000 dstport 8125 payload "statsd.batch.part_b:1|c" wait 5ms

    // Wake-on-LAN magic packet on VLAN 25, UDP port 9
    src -> bcast vlan 25 dstmac ff:ff:ff:ff:ff:ff udp srcport 49152 dstport 9 hexpayload "ffffffffffff001b21aabbcc001b21aabbcc001b21aabbcc001b21aabbcc"
}

compile { udp_diagnostics(workstation, hop1_rtr, target_srv, lan_bcast) }
```

```frameassembly
host gnb_n2 { ip 2001:db8:5000:a2::10 }
host amf_n2 { ip 2001:db8:5000:a2::1 }

flow sctp_5g_n2_setup(gnb, amf) {
    gnb -> amf dscp 46 sctp chunk init vtag 0 srcport 38412 dstport 38412 wait 1ms
    gnb <- amf dscp 46 sctp chunk initack vtag 384120 srcport 38412 dstport 38412 wait 1ms
    gnb -> amf dscp 46 sctp chunk cookieecho vtag 384120 srcport 38412 dstport 38412 payload "state_cookie_n2" wait 1ms
    gnb <- amf dscp 46 sctp chunk cookieack vtag 384120 srcport 38412 dstport 38412 wait 1ms
    gnb -> amf dscp 46 sctp chunk data vtag 384120 stream 0 ssn 0 ppid 60 srcport 38412 dstport 38412 payload "ngap_ng_setup_request_gnb_001" wait 2ms
    gnb <- amf dscp 46 sctp chunk sack vtag 384120 srcport 38412 dstport 38412
}

compile { sctp_5g_n2_setup(gnb_n2, amf_n2) }
```

### SNMPv3 authPriv Trap/Inform/Get, SNMPv1/v2c Varbinds (`docs/06_l7_snmp.md`)

```frameassembly
host core_sw { ip 10.10.1.2  mac 00:1a:2b:3c:4d:01 }
host zabbix  { ip 10.10.1.50 mac 00:1a:2b:3c:4d:50 }

flow authpriv_trap(sw, nms) {
    // linkDown for ifIndex 1, encrypted. Wireshark steps below use these exact credentials.
    sw -> nms vlan 100 snmp3 trap user "netops" engineid "80001f8801" engineboots 5 enginetime 3600 auth sha256 "AuthPass123!" priv aes "PrivPass123!" sysuptime 432005 oid 1.3.6.1.6.3.1.1.5.3 varbind 1.3.6.1.2.1.2.2.1.8.1 int 2
}

compile { authpriv_trap(core_sw, zabbix) }
```

```frameassembly
host core_rtr { ip 10.151.0.1   mac 00:25:90:51:00:01 }
host nms_srv  { ip 10.151.0.250 mac 00:25:90:51:00:fa }

flow acknowledged_inform(rtr, nms) {
    // BGP peer state change, SHA-512 + AES-128, delivered to UDP 162 and acknowledged
    rtr -> nms dscp 16 snmp3 inform dstport 162 user "ops_v3" engineid "80001f8880510001" engineboots 30 enginetime 400001 contextname "core-fabric" auth sha512 "HighSecSha512!" priv aes "HighSecAes128!" reqid 9702 sysuptime 40000100 oid 1.3.6.1.2.1.15.7.2 varbind 1.3.6.1.2.1.15.3.1.2.198.51.100.2 int 1 wait 2ms
    rtr <- nms dscp 16 snmp3 response user "ops_v3" engineid "80001f8880510001" engineboots 30 enginetime 400001 contextname "core-fabric" auth sha512 "HighSecSha512!" priv aes "HighSecAes128!" reqid 9702 varbind 1.3.6.1.2.1.15.3.1.2.198.51.100.2 int 1
}

compile { acknowledged_inform(core_rtr, nms_srv) }
```

```frameassembly
host poller    { ip 10.156.0.10 mac 00:1b:54:56:00:10 }
host pe_router { ip 10.156.0.1  mac 00:1b:54:56:00:01 }

flow poll_400g_counters(nms, pe) {
    // nonrepeaters 1 fetches sysUpTime.0 once; the ifHCInOctets column repeats up to 10 times
    nms -> pe snmp2 getbulk community "telemetry_ro" reqid 7001 nonrepeaters 1 maxrepetitions 10 varbind 1.3.6.1.2.1.1.3.0 null varbind 1.3.6.1.2.1.31.1.1.1.6 null wait 2ms
    nms <- pe snmp2 response community "telemetry_ro" reqid 7001 varbind 1.3.6.1.2.1.1.3.0 timeticks 8640000 varbind 1.3.6.1.2.1.1.2.0 oidval 1.3.6.1.4.1.30065.1.3011 varbind 1.3.6.1.2.1.31.1.1.1.1.1 string "Ethernet1/1" varbind 1.3.6.1.2.1.31.1.1.1.6.1 counter64 2199023255552 varbind 1.3.6.1.2.1.2.2.1.14.1 counter32 0 varbind 1.3.6.1.2.1.31.1.1.1.15.1 gauge32 400000 varbind 1.3.6.1.4.1.9.9.91.1.1.1.1.4.1 int -7
}

compile { poll_400g_counters(poller, pe_router) }
```

### Modbus, S7comm, DNP3 CRC-16, BACnet, EtherNet/IP & OPC UA (`docs/10_l7_industrial_ot.md`)

```frameassembly
host scada_hmi { ip 172.22.10.10 mac 00:1b:21:10:00:0a }
host rogue_eng { ip 172.22.99.66 mac 00:50:56:99:00:66 }
host line_plc  { ip 172.22.10.50 mac 00:0e:8c:10:00:32 }

flow modbus_policy_check(hmi, rogue, plc) {
    // Allowed: the HMI polls 4 holding registers on VLAN 110 (802.1p PCP 6)
    hmi -> plc vlan 110 pcp 6 tcp syn srcport 50502 dstport 502 win 64240 mss 1460 wait 1ms
    hmi <- plc vlan 110 pcp 6 tcp syn ack win 64240 mss 1460 wait 1ms
    hmi -> plc vlan 110 pcp 6 tcp ack wait 1ms
    hmi -> plc vlan 110 pcp 6 modbus readholdingregisters txid 1 unitid 1 addr 100 count 4 wait 2ms
    hmi <- plc vlan 110 pcp 6 modbus readholdingregisters txid 1 unitid 1 count 4 value 1500 isresponse wait 2ms
    // Violation: a rogue host writes Single Register (function 0x06)
    rogue -> plc vlan 110 modbus writesingleregister txid 99 unitid 1 addr 100 value 0xffff wait 2ms
    rogue <- plc vlan 110 tcp rst ack
}

compile { modbus_policy_check(scada_hmi, rogue_eng, line_plc) }
```

```frameassembly
host workstation { ip 10.10.50.100 mac 00:22:44:66:88:aa }
host access_sw   { ip 10.10.50.1   mac 00:11:22:33:44:01 }
host radius_srv  { ip 10.10.1.10   mac 00:11:22:33:44:10 }
host nms_srv     { ip 10.10.1.20   mac 00:11:22:33:44:20 }

flow campus_dot1x_onboarding(ws, sw, aaa, nms) {
    // 1. IEEE 802.1X EAPOL Start and EAP-Identity exchange
    ws -> sw eapol version 2 type start wait 2ms
    ws <- sw eapol version 2 type eappacket eapcode 1 eapid 1 eapmethod 1 wait 2ms
    ws -> sw eapol version 2 type eappacket eapcode 2 eapid 1 eapmethod 1 identity "eng-laptop-42" wait 2ms

    // 2. RADIUS Access-Request / Access-Accept and EAP-Success (eapcode 3)
    sw -> aaa radius accessrequest id 42 user "eng-laptop-42" nasip 10.10.50.1 wait 5ms
    sw <- aaa radius accessaccept id 42 framedip 10.10.50.100 wait 2ms
    ws <- sw eapol version 2 type eappacket eapcode 3 eapid 1 wait 5ms

    // 3. DHCPv4 DORA lease acquisition (Discover -> Offer -> Request -> Ack)
    ws -> sw dhcp discover xid 0xabcdef01 chaddr 00:22:44:66:88:aa wait 5ms
    ws <- sw dhcp offer xid 0xabcdef01 chaddr 00:22:44:66:88:aa yiaddr 10.10.50.100 router 10.10.50.1 dnsserver 10.10.1.53 subnetmask 255.255.255.0 leasetime 43200 wait 5ms
    ws -> sw dhcp request xid 0xabcdef01 chaddr 00:22:44:66:88:aa yiaddr 10.10.50.100 wait 5ms
    ws <- sw dhcp ack xid 0xabcdef01 chaddr 00:22:44:66:88:aa yiaddr 10.10.50.100 router 10.10.50.1 dnsserver 10.10.1.53 subnetmask 255.255.255.0 leasetime 43200 wait 5ms

    // 4. RFC 5227 Gratuitous ARP announcement
    ws -> sw arp gratuitous sha 00:22:44:66:88:aa spa 10.10.50.100 tpa 10.10.50.100 wait 2ms

    // 5. SNMPv3 USM authPriv (HMAC-SHA-256 + AES-128) Inform to NMS
    sw -> nms snmp3 inform user "nac_auditor" engineid "80001f88801122334455" engineboots 5 enginetime 3600 auth sha256 "AuditAuthKey2026!" priv aes "AuditPrivKey2026!" reqid 500 varbind 1.3.6.1.2.1.1.5.0 string "access-sw-floor2" varbind 1.3.6.1.2.1.2.2.1.8.12 int 1
}

compile {
    campus_dot1x_onboarding(workstation, access_sw, radius_srv, nms_srv)
}
```

```frameassembly
host branch_r1 { ip 10.250.10.2  mac 00:00:5e:00:01:0a }
host branch_r2 { ip 10.250.10.3  mac 00:1e:be:25:10:03 }
host hq_hub    { ip 172.31.250.1 mac 00:1e:be:31:fa:01 }

flow wan_failover_and_ipsec_mpls(r1, r2, hub) {
    // 1. VRRPv3 LAN gateway advertisement and preemptive priority takeover on VRID 10
    r1 -> r2 vrrp vrid 10 priority 200 advint 100 vip 10.250.10.1 version 3 ttl 255 wait 2ms

    // 2. BFD Down notification (state 1, diag 1) triggers OSPF Area 0 LSA flooding
    r1 -> r2 bfd state 1 diag 1 mydisc 501 yourdisc 502 mintx 100000 minrx 100000 mult 3 ttl 255 wait 2ms
    r2 -> r1 vrrp vrid 10 priority 220 advint 100 vip 10.250.10.1 version 3 ttl 255 wait 2ms
    r1 -> r2 ospf hello routerid 10.250.0.1 areaid 0 hellointerval 10 deadinterval 40 priority 100 ttl 1 wait 1ms
    r1 -> r2 ospf lsu routerid 10.250.0.1 areaid 0 ttl 1 wait 1ms
    r1 <- r2 ospf lsack routerid 10.250.0.2 areaid 0 ttl 1 wait 3ms

    // 3. IKEv2 SA_INIT and AUTH negotiation over IEEE 802.1ad QinQ (S-VLAN 2100, C-VLAN 100)
    r2 -> hub qinq 2100 innervlan 100 dscp 48 ikev2 exchange sainit initiatorspi 0x1122334455667788 responderspi 0 msgid 0 flags 0x08 wait 2ms
    r2 <- hub qinq 2100 innervlan 100 dscp 48 ikev2 exchange sainit initiatorspi 0x1122334455667788 responderspi 0x99aabbccddeeff00 msgid 0 flags 0x20 wait 2ms
    r2 -> hub qinq 2100 innervlan 100 dscp 48 ikev2 exchange auth initiatorspi 0x1122334455667788 responderspi 0x99aabbccddeeff00 msgid 1 flags 0x08 wait 2ms
    r2 <- hub qinq 2100 innervlan 100 dscp 48 ikev2 exchange auth initiatorspi 0x1122334455667788 responderspi 0x99aabbccddeeff00 msgid 1 flags 0x20 wait 3ms

    // 4. Encrypted IPsec ESP tunnel traffic over MPLS Label 32100 (EXP 5 EF)
    r2 -> hub mpls 32100 exp 5 bos 1 mplsttl 60 dscp 46 esp spi 0x00102030 seq 1 iv "1122334455667788" icv "aabbccddeeff001122334455" nextheader 4 payload "ENCRYPTED_BRANCH_VOICE_FRAME_1" wait 2ms
    r2 <- hub mpls 32200 exp 5 bos 1 mplsttl 60 dscp 46 esp spi 0x00102031 seq 1 iv "8877665544332211" icv "554433221100ffeeddccbbaa" nextheader 4 payload "ENCRYPTED_HQ_VOICE_REPLY_1"
}

compile {
    wan_failover_and_ipsec_mpls(branch_r1, branch_r2, hq_hub)
}
```

## 6. Formal ISO/IEC 14977 EBNF Grammar (`grammar.ebnf`) & API / Docs Reference

> Note: Constrained decoding grammars `frameassembly.gbnf` (`llama.cpp` / `XGrammar`) and `frameassembly.lark` (`Outlines` / `vLLM` / `llguidance`) are also available in the repository root and track `grammar.ebnf` in lockstep.

```ebnf
(* ========================================================================= *)
(* FrameAssembly Formal Grammar Specification (ISO/IEC 14977 EBNF)           *)
(* Covers all 81 native protocols, L2-L7 sub-keywords, modifiers & literals. *)
(* Synchronized with src/lexer/mod.rs and src/parser/                        *)
(* Note: FrameAssembly v3.0.0 (.frasm) enforces strict-lowercase alphanumeric  *)
(* syntax without '_' or '-' on all built-in keywords, protocols, modifiers & units.*)
(* ========================================================================= *)

program                 = { top_level_decl } , compile_block , { top_level_decl } ;

top_level_decl          = host_declaration | flow_declaration ;

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 1. Host Declarations (at least one IP or MAC property in any order)       *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
host_declaration        = "host" , identifier , "{" , host_property , { host_property } , "}" ;
host_property           = ( "ip" , ip_address )
                        | ( "mac" , mac_address ) ;

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 2. Flow Declarations & Frame Statements (FLOW blocks are optional when    *)
(*    COMPILE contains inline frame_statement entries)                       *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
flow_declaration        = "flow" , identifier , "(" , [ param_list ] , ")" ,
                          "{" , { frame_statement } , "}" ;
param_list              = identifier , { "," , identifier } ;

frame_statement         = endpoint , direction , endpoint , { frame_field } ;
endpoint                = identifier ;
direction               = "->" | "<-" ;

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 3. Compilation Block & Inline Frame Statements                            *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
compile_block           = "compile" , "{" , { run_statement } , "}" ;
run_statement           = flow_invocation | frame_statement ;
flow_invocation         = identifier , "(" , [ arg_list ] , ")" ;
arg_list                = identifier , { "," , identifier } ;

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 4. Frame Fields (Protocols, Modifiers & Protocol-Specific Attributes)     *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
frame_field             = protocol_keyword
                        | universal_modifier
                        | l2_modifier
                        | l3_modifier
                        | l4_modifier
                        | l2_protocol_field
                        | l3_protocol_field
                        | l4_protocol_field
                        | snmp_protocol_field
                        | l7_protocol_field ;

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 5. All 81 Native Protocol Keywords                                        *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
protocol_keyword        = l2_protocol
                        | l3_protocol
                        | l4_protocol
                        | snmp_protocol
                        | l7_infra_protocol
                        | l7_app_protocol
                        | l7_ot_protocol ;

(* Layer 2 Data-Link Protocols (8) *)
l2_protocol             = "arp" | "vlan" | "qinq" | "lldp"
                        | "stp" | "lacp" | "eapol" | "mpls" ;

(* Layer 3 Network, Tunneling, Security & Routing Protocols (20) *)
l3_protocol             = "icmp" | "ndp" | "igmp" | "mld"
                        | "gre" | "vxlan" | "geneve"
                        | "ipsec" | "esp" | "ah" | "ikev2" | "wireguard"
                        | "ospf" | "bgp" | "rip" | "vrrp" | "hsrp"
                        | "pim" | "bfd" | "openflow" ;

(* Layer 4 Transport Protocols (3) *)
l4_protocol             = "tcp" | "udp" | "sctp" ;

(* Layer 7 SNMP Protocols (3) *)
snmp_protocol           = "snmp1" | "snmp2" | "snmp3" ;

(* Layer 7 Infrastructure, Management & Telemetry Protocols (11) *)
l7_infra_protocol       = "dns" | "mdns" | "dhcp" | "ntp" | "ptp"
                        | "radius" | "tacacs" | "syslog"
                        | "netflow" | "ipfix" | "sflow" ;

(* Layer 7 Web, Application, Directory, Mail, Storage & Messaging Protocols (30) *)
l7_app_protocol         = "tftp" | "ftp" | "ssh" | "telnet"
                        | "http" | "http2" | "grpc" | "websocket"
                        | "tls" | "quic" | "stun" | "sip" | "rtp" | "rtsp"
                        | "smtp" | "imap" | "pop3"
                        | "kerberos" | "ldap" | "smb" | "nfs"
                        | "redis" | "memcached" | "mysql" | "postgres"
                        | "mqtt" | "coap" | "amqp" | "ssdp" | "whois" ;

(* Layer 7 Industrial / Operational Technology (SCADA/OT) Protocols (6) *)
l7_ot_protocol          = "modbus" | "bacnet" | "dnp3"
                        | "s7comm" | "ethernetip" | "opcua" ;

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 6. Universal, Layer 2, Layer 3 & Layer 4 Frame Modifiers                  *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
universal_modifier      = ( "wait" , duration_literal )
                        | ( "payload" , string_literal )
                        | ( "hexpayload" , hex_string_literal ) ;

l2_modifier             = ( "srcmac" , mac_address )
                        | ( "dstmac" , mac_address )
                        | ( "ethertype" , unsigned_int )
                        | ( "vlan" , [ unsigned_int ] )
                        | ( "pcp" , unsigned_int )
                        | ( "dei" , unsigned_int )
                        | ( "qinq" , [ unsigned_int ] )
                        | ( "innervlan" , unsigned_int )
                        | ( "mpls" , [ unsigned_int ] )
                        | ( "label" , unsigned_int )
                        | ( ( "exp" | "tc" ) , unsigned_int )
                        | ( "bos" , unsigned_int )
                        | ( "mplsttl" , unsigned_int ) ;

l3_modifier             = ( "ttl" , unsigned_int )
                        | ( "dscp" , unsigned_int )
                        | ( "ecn" , unsigned_int )
                        | ( "flowlabel" , unsigned_int )
                        | ( "ipid" , unsigned_int )
                        | "df"
                        | "mf"
                        | ( "fragoffset" , unsigned_int )
                        | ( "nextheader" , unsigned_int ) ;

l4_modifier             = ( "srcport" , unsigned_int )
                        | ( "dstport" , unsigned_int )
                        | ( "transport" , ( "tcp" | "udp" ) )
                        | tcp_flag
                        | ( "seq" , unsigned_int )
                        | ( "acknum" , unsigned_int )
                        | ( ( "win" | "window" ) , unsigned_int )
                        | ( "urgent" , unsigned_int )
                        | ( "mss" , unsigned_int )
                        | ( "wscale" , unsigned_int )
                        | "sackperm"
                        | ( "tsval" , unsigned_int )
                        | ( "tsecr" , unsigned_int ) ;

tcp_flag                = "syn" | "ack" | "fin" | "rst"
                        | "psh" | "urg" | "ece" | "cwr" ;

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 7. Layer 2 Protocol Sub-Keywords                                          *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
l2_protocol_field       = arp_field | lldp_field | stp_field
                        | lacp_field | eapol_field ;

arp_field               = "request"
                        | ( "reply" , [ string_literal ] )
                        | "gratuitous" | "garp"
                        | ( ( "sha" | "sendermac" ) , mac_address )
                        | ( ( "spa" | "senderip" ) , ip_address )
                        | ( ( "tha" | "targetmac" ) , mac_address )
                        | ( ( "tpa" | "targetip" ) , ip_address ) ;

lldp_field              = ( "chassisid" , str_or_ident )
                        | ( "portid" , ( unsigned_int | str_or_ident ) )
                        | ( "sysname" , str_or_ident )
                        | ( "sysdesc" , str_or_ident ) ;

stp_field               = ( "rootid" , str_or_ident )
                        | ( "bridgeid" , str_or_ident )
                        | ( "cost" , unsigned_int )
                        | ( "maxage" , unsigned_int )
                        | ( "hellotime" , unsigned_int )
                        | ( "forwarddelay" , unsigned_int )
                        | "rstp"
                        | ( "flags" , unsigned_int ) ;

lacp_field              = ( "actorsys" , ( mac_address | string_literal ) )
                        | ( "actorkey" , unsigned_int )
                        | ( "actorport" , unsigned_int )
                        | ( "partnersys" , ( mac_address | string_literal ) )
                        | ( "partnerkey" , unsigned_int )
                        | ( "partnerport" , unsigned_int )
                        | ( "actorstate" , unsigned_int )
                        | ( "partnerstate" , unsigned_int ) ;

eapol_field             = ( "version" , ( unsigned_int | str_or_ident ) )
                        | ( "type" , ( unsigned_int | eapol_pkt_type | wireguard_pkt_type
                                     | openflow_pkt_type | tacacs_pkt_type | str_or_ident ) )
                        | eapol_pkt_type
                        | ( "eapcode" , unsigned_int )
                        | ( "eapid" , unsigned_int )
                        | ( "eapmethod" , unsigned_int )
                        | ( "identity" , str_or_ident ) ;

eapol_pkt_type          = "start" | "logoff" | "key" | "eappacket" ;
wireguard_pkt_type      = "initiation" | "response" | "cookie" | "data" ;
openflow_pkt_type       = "hello" | "featuresreq" | "featuresreply"
                        | "packetin" | "packetout" | "flowmod"
                        | "echoreq" | "echorequest" | "echoreply" ;
tacacs_pkt_type         = "authen" | "author" | "acct" ;

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 8. Layer 3 Protocol Sub-Keywords                                          *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
l3_protocol_field       = icmp_field | ndp_field | igmp_field | mld_field
                        | gre_field | vxlan_geneve_field | ipsec_esp_ah_field
                        | ikev2_field | wireguard_field | ospf_field
                        | bgp_field | rip_field | vrrp_field | hsrp_field
                        | pim_field | bfd_field | openflow_field ;

icmp_field              = "echorequest" | "echoreply" | "destunreach"
                        | "timeexceeded" | "redirect"
                        | ( "code" , ( unsigned_int | str_or_ident ) )
                        | ( "id" , unsigned_int )
                        | ( "gateway" , ip_address ) ;

ndp_field               = "routersolicit" | "routeradvert"
                        | "neighborsolicit" | "neighboradvert"
                        | ( "target" , ( ip_address | mac_address ) )
                        | ( "slla" , mac_address )
                        | ( "tlla" , mac_address )
                        | ( "routerlifetime" , unsigned_int ) ;

igmp_field              = "query" | "report" | "leave"
                        | "v1" | "v2" | "v3"
                        | ( "group" , ( ip_address | unsigned_int ) )
                        | ( "maxresp" , unsigned_int ) ;

mld_field               = "done"
                        | ( "multicastaddr" , ip_address )
                        | ( "maxrespdelay" , unsigned_int ) ;

gre_field               = "checksum"
                        | ( "grekey" , unsigned_int )
                        | ( "greseq" , unsigned_int )
                        | ( "greproto" , unsigned_int ) ;

vxlan_geneve_field      = ( ( "vni" | "vnid" ) , unsigned_int )
                        | ( "optclass" , unsigned_int )
                        | ( "opttype" , unsigned_int )
                        | ( "protocoltype" , unsigned_int ) ;

ipsec_esp_ah_field      = ( "spi" , unsigned_int )
                        | ( "iv" , ( hex_string_literal | unsigned_int ) )
                        | ( "icv" , ( hex_string_literal | unsigned_int ) ) ;

ikev2_field             = ( "initiatorspi" , ( unsigned_int | hex_string_literal ) )
                        | ( "responderspi" , ( unsigned_int | hex_string_literal ) )
                        | ( "exchange" , ( unsigned_int | ikev2_exchange_mode | str_or_ident ) )
                        | ikev2_exchange_mode
                        | ( "msgid" , ( unsigned_int | str_or_ident ) )
                        | ( "nextpayload" , unsigned_int ) ;

ikev2_exchange_mode     = "sainit" | "createchildsa" | "informational" ;

wireguard_field         = "initiation"
                        | ( "cookie" , [ str_or_ident ] )
                        | ( "data" , [ str_or_ident ] )
                        | ( "sender" , unsigned_int )
                        | ( "receiver" , unsigned_int )
                        | ( "counter" , unsigned_int ) ;

ospf_field              = "hello" | "dbd" | "lsr" | "lsu" | "lsack"
                        | ( "routerid" , ip_address )
                        | ( "areaid" , ( unsigned_int | ip_address ) )
                        | ( "hellointerval" , unsigned_int )
                        | ( "deadinterval" , unsigned_int )
                        | ( "priority" , unsigned_int ) ;

bgp_field               = "open" | "update" | "notification"
                        | ( "keepalive" , [ unsigned_int ] )
                        | ( "asn" , unsigned_int )
                        | ( "holdtime" , unsigned_int )
                        | ( "bgpid" , ip_address )
                        | ( ( "prefix" | "nlri" ) , ( ip_address | str_or_ident ) )
                        | ( "nexthop" , ip_address ) ;

rip_field               = ( "command" , ( unsigned_int | str_or_ident ) )
                        | ( "metric" , unsigned_int )
                        | ( "tag" , ( unsigned_int | str_or_ident ) ) ;

vrrp_field              = ( "vrid" , unsigned_int )
                        | ( "advint" , unsigned_int )
                        | ( "vip" , ip_address ) ;

hsrp_field              = ( "hellotime" , unsigned_int )
                        | ( "state" , unsigned_int ) ;

pim_field               = "joinprune" | "register"
                        | ( "source" , ip_address )
                        | ( "rp" , ip_address )
                        | ( "drpriority" , unsigned_int ) ;

bfd_field               = ( "diag" , unsigned_int )
                        | ( "mydisc" , unsigned_int )
                        | ( "yourdisc" , unsigned_int )
                        | ( "mintx" , unsigned_int )
                        | ( "minrx" , unsigned_int )
                        | ( "mult" , unsigned_int ) ;

openflow_field          = "featuresreq" | "featuresreply"
                        | "packetin" | "packetout"
                        | "flowmod" | "echoreq"
                        | ( "xid" , unsigned_int )
                        | ( "dpid" , unsigned_int )
                        | ( "tableid" , unsigned_int ) ;

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 9. Layer 4 SCTP Sub-Keywords                                              *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
l4_protocol_field       = ( "vtag" , unsigned_int )
                        | ( "stream" , unsigned_int )
                        | ( "ssn" , unsigned_int )
                        | ( "ppid" , unsigned_int )
                        | ( "tsn" , unsigned_int )
                        | ( "chunk" , ( sctp_chunk_flag | unsigned_int | str_or_ident ) )
                        | sctp_chunk_flag ;

sctp_chunk_flag         = "data" | "init" | "initack" | "sack"
                        | "heartbeat" | "heartbeatack"
                        | "abort" | "shutdown" | "shutdownack"
                        | "cookieecho" | "cookieack" ;

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 10. SNMPv1 / SNMPv2c / SNMPv3 Sub-Keywords                                *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
snmp_protocol_field     = snmp_pdu_type
                        | snmp_common_field
                        | snmp_v1_field
                        | snmp_v3_field
                        | snmp_varbind ;

snmp_pdu_type           = "trap" | "inform" | "get" | "getnext"
                        | "getbulk" | "set"
                        | ( "response" , [ str_or_ident ] )
                        | "report" ;

snmp_common_field       = ( "community" , string_literal )
                        | ( "oid" , oid_literal )
                        | ( "sysuptime" , unsigned_int )
                        | ( "reqid" , unsigned_int )
                        | ( "nonrepeaters" , unsigned_int )
                        | ( "maxrepetitions" , unsigned_int ) ;

snmp_v1_field           = ( "enterprise" , oid_literal )
                        | ( "agentip" , ip_address )
                        | ( "gentrap" , unsigned_int )
                        | ( "spectrap" , unsigned_int ) ;

snmp_v3_field           = ( "user" , str_or_ident )
                        | ( "engineid" , string_literal )
                        | ( "engineboots" , unsigned_int )
                        | ( "enginetime" , unsigned_int )
                        | ( "contextname" , string_literal )
                        | ( "auth" , snmp_auth_proto , string_literal )
                        | ( "priv" , snmp_priv_proto , string_literal ) ;

snmp_auth_proto         = "md5" | "sha" | "sha256" | "sha384" | "sha512" ;
snmp_priv_proto         = "des" | "aes" ;

snmp_varbind            = "varbind" , oid_literal , varbind_type_val ;
varbind_type_val        = "nullval" | "null"
                        | ( "string" , string_literal )
                        | ( "int" , signed_int )
                        | ( "timeticks" , unsigned_int )
                        | ( "ipval" , ip_address )
                        | ( "oidval" , oid_literal )
                        | ( "counter32" , unsigned_int )
                        | ( "gauge32" , unsigned_int )
                        | ( "counter64" , unsigned_int ) ;

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 11. Layer 7 Infrastructure, App, Telemetry & OT Protocol Sub-Keywords     *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
l7_protocol_field       = l7_dns_dhcp_field
                        | l7_ntp_ptp_aaa_field
                        | l7_telemetry_field
                        | l7_web_transfer_field
                        | l7_tls_quic_voip_field
                        | l7_mail_auth_dir_field
                        | l7_db_cache_mq_field
                        | l7_industrial_ot_field ;

l7_dns_dhcp_field       = ( "txid" , ( unsigned_int | str_or_ident ) )
                        | ( "qname" , str_or_ident )
                        | ( "qtype" , ( unsigned_int | str_or_ident ) )
                        | ( "rdata" , str_or_ident )
                        | ( "rcode" , unsigned_int )
                        | ( "ansttl" , unsigned_int )
                        | "discover" | "solicit" | "offer" | "advertise" | "release"
                        | ( "ciaddr" , ip_address )
                        | ( "yiaddr" , ip_address )
                        | ( "siaddr" , ip_address )
                        | ( "chaddr" , mac_address )
                        | ( "hostname" , str_or_ident )
                        | ( "dnsserver" , ip_address )
                        | ( "router" , ip_address )
                        | ( "subnetmask" , ip_address )
                        | ( "leasetime" , unsigned_int ) ;

l7_ntp_ptp_aaa_field    = ( "li" , unsigned_int )
                        | ( "vn" , unsigned_int )
                        | ( "mode" , ( unsigned_int | str_or_ident ) )
                        | ( "stratum" , unsigned_int )
                        | ( "poll" , unsigned_int )
                        | ( "precision" , signed_int )
                        | ( "refid" , str_or_ident )
                        | ( "txtimestamp" , unsigned_int )
                        | ( "msgtype" , ( unsigned_int | str_or_ident ) )
                        | "sync" | "delayreq" | "followup" | "delayresp" | "announce"
                        | ( "domain" , ( unsigned_int | str_or_ident ) )
                        | ( "seqid" , unsigned_int )
                        | ( "clockid" , ( mac_address | str_or_ident ) )
                        | "accessrequest" | "accessaccept" | "accessreject"
                        | "accesschallenge" | "accountingrequest" | "accountingresponse"
                        | ( "nasip" , ip_address )
                        | ( "servicetype" , unsigned_int )
                        | ( "framedip" , ip_address )
                        | "authen" | "author" | "acct"
                        | ( "sessionid" , unsigned_int ) ;

l7_telemetry_field      = ( "facility" , unsigned_int )
                        | ( "severity" , unsigned_int )
                        | ( "pri" , unsigned_int )
                        | ( "app" , str_or_ident )
                        | ( "procid" , str_or_ident )
                        | ( "msg" , str_or_ident )
                        | ( "srcip" , ip_address )
                        | ( "dstip" , ip_address )
                        | ( "proto" , unsigned_int )
                        | ( "packets" , unsigned_int )

                        | ( "banner" , str_or_ident )

                        | ( "msgcode" , unsigned_int )
                        | ( "will" , unsigned_int )
                        | ( "wont" , unsigned_int )
                        | ( "do" , unsigned_int )
                        | ( "dont" , unsigned_int )
                        | ( "option" , unsigned_int )
                        | "post" | "put" | "delete" | "head" | "options" | "patch"
                        | ( "uri" , str_or_ident )
                        | ( "hosthdr" , str_or_ident )
                        | ( "useragent" , str_or_ident )
                        | ( "contenttype" , str_or_ident )
                        | ( "status" , ( unsigned_int | str_or_ident ) )
                        | ( "reason" , str_or_ident )

l7_mail_auth_dir_field  = ( "ehlo" , [ str_or_ident ] )
                        | ( "helo" , [ str_or_ident ] )
                        | ( "mailfrom" , [ str_or_ident ] )
                        | ( "rcptto" , [ str_or_ident ] )
                        | "quit"
                        | ( "param" , str_or_ident )
                        | "ok" | "err"
                        | "asreq" | "asrep" | "tgsreq" | "tgsrep" | "krberror"
                        | ( "realm" , str_or_ident )
                        | ( "cname" , str_or_ident )
                        | ( "sname" , str_or_ident )
                        | ( "etype" , unsigned_int )
                        | "bindreq" | "bindres" | "searchreq"
                        | "searchentry" | "searchdone" | "unbindreq"
                        | ( "basedn" , str_or_ident )
                        | ( "filter" , str_or_ident )
                        | ( "resultcode" , unsigned_int )
                        | ( "command" , str_or_ident )
                        | "negotiate" | "sessionsetup" | "treeconnect"
                        | "create" | "treedisconnect"
                        | ( "treeid" , unsigned_int )
                        | ( "share" , str_or_ident )
                        | ( "vers" , unsigned_int )
                        | ( "proc" , ( unsigned_int | str_or_ident ) )
                        | ( "path" , str_or_ident )
                        | "compound" ;

l7_db_cache_mq_field    = ( "args" , str_or_ident )
                        | ( "replytype" , str_or_ident )
                        | ( "key" , ( unsigned_int | str_or_ident ) )
                        | ( "value" , ( unsigned_int | str_or_ident ) )
                        | ( "exptime" , unsigned_int )
                        | ( "opaque" , unsigned_int )
                        | ( "cas" , unsigned_int )
                        | "greeting" | "login" | "eof"
                        | ( "sql" , str_or_ident )
                        | ( "serverversion" , str_or_ident )
                        | ( "db" , str_or_ident )
                        | "startup" | "readyforquery" | "commandcomplete"
                        | "errorresponse" | "authok"
                        | "connect" | "connack" | "publish" | "puback"
                        | "subscribe" | "suback" | "pingreq" | "pingresp" | "disconnect"
                        | ( "clientid" , str_or_ident )
                        | ( "topic" , str_or_ident )
                        | ( "qos" , unsigned_int )
                        | ( "retain" , [ unsigned_int ] )
                        | ( "pkttype" , ( unsigned_int | str_or_ident ) )
                        | ( "pktid" , unsigned_int )
                        | ( "returncode" , unsigned_int )
                        | "con" | "non" | "changed" | "created" | "notfound"
                        | ( "uripath" , str_or_ident )
                        | ( "contentformat" , unsigned_int )
                        | "protocolheader" | "connectionstart" | "channelopen"
                        | "basicpublish" | "basicdeliver"
                        | ( "channel" , unsigned_int )

                        | "msearch" | "notify"

l7_industrial_ot_field  = ( "protoid" , unsigned_int )
                        | ( "unitid" , unsigned_int )

                        | "readcoils" | "readdiscreteinputs"

                        | "directoperate" | "unsolicitedresponse"

                        | ( "src" , unsigned_int )
                        | ( "dst" , unsigned_int )
                        | ( "rosctr" , ( unsigned_int | str_or_ident ) )
                        | ( "pduref" , unsigned_int )
                        | "setupcomm" | "readvar" | "writevar" | "plccontrol"
                        | ( "area" , ( unsigned_int | str_or_ident ) )

                        | ( "offset" , unsigned_int )

                        | ( "context" , ( unsigned_int | str_or_ident ) )

                        | ( "cipattr" , unsigned_int )
                        | ( "chunktype" , str_or_ident )

                        | ( "tokenid" , unsigned_int )
                        | ( "seqnum" , unsigned_int )
                        | ( "endpointurl" , str_or_ident )
                        | ( "nodeid" , str_or_ident ) ;

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 12. Lexical Terminals                                                     *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
str_or_ident            = string_literal | identifier ;
(* Matches /[a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_]*(-[a-zA-Z0-9_]+)*/ *)
identifier              = ( letter | "_" ) , { letter | digit | "_" } ,
                          { "-" , ( letter | digit | "_" ) , { letter | digit | "_" } } ;
unsigned_int            = decimal_int | hex_int ;
signed_int              = [ "-" ] , decimal_int | hex_int ;
decimal_int             = digit , { digit } ;
hex_int                 = ( "0x" | "0X" ) , hex_digit , { hex_digit } ;
duration_literal        = unsigned_int , time_unit ;
time_unit               = "ns" | "us" | "ms" | "s" | "m" ;
string_literal          = '"' , { string_char | escape_sequence } , '"' ;
string_char             = " ".."!" | "#".."[" | "]".."~" ;
hex_string_literal      = '"' , { hex_digit | ":" | " " } , '"' ;
escape_sequence         = "\" , ( "r" | "n" | "t" | "\" | '"' | "'"
                                | ( "x" , hex_digit , hex_digit )
                                | ( "u" , hex_digit , hex_digit , hex_digit , hex_digit ) ) ;
mac_address             = ( hex_byte , ":" , hex_byte , ":" , hex_byte , ":" ,
                            hex_byte , ":" , hex_byte , ":" , hex_byte )
                        | ( hex_byte , "-" , hex_byte , "-" , hex_byte , "-" ,
                            hex_byte , "-" , hex_byte , "-" , hex_byte )
                        | ( hex_word , "." , hex_word , "." , hex_word ) ;
hex_byte                = hex_digit , hex_digit ;
hex_word                = hex_digit , hex_digit , hex_digit , hex_digit ;
ip_address              = ipv4_address | ipv6_address ;
ipv4_address            = decimal_int , "." , decimal_int , "." , decimal_int , "." , decimal_int ;
ipv6_address            = ( "::" , { hex_digit | ":" | "." } )
                        | ( hex_digit , [ hex_digit ] , [ hex_digit ] , [ hex_digit ] ,
                            ":" , { hex_digit | ":" | "." } ) ;
oid_literal             = [ "." ] , decimal_int , { "." , decimal_int } | string_literal ;
letter                  = "A".."Z" | "a".."z" ;
digit                   = "0".."9" ;
hex_digit               = digit | "A".."F" | "a".."f" ;
```

### CLI Commands, Rust Crate & WebAssembly (`3.0.0`)
- **CLI (default root compile + 4 subcommands; no `-o`/`--output`)**:
  - `frameassembly demo.frasm [output.pcap]` (compiles `.frasm` -> `.pcap` / `.pcapng`; defaults to `<input_stem>.pcap`)
  - `frameassembly show demo.frasm` (prints packet ladder timestamps, endpoints, protocols, ports, flags, bytes)
  - `frameassembly reverse capture.pcap [output.frasm]` (decompiles `.pcap`/`.pcapng` -> canonical `.frasm`; defaults to `<input_stem>.frasm`)
  - `frameassembly help [subcommand]` | `frameassembly version` (`frameassembly 3.0.0`)
- **Rust Crate (`frameassembly = "3.0.0"`)**: `lexer::lex`, `parser::parse_program`, `parser::validate_semantics`, `backend::compile_program`, `backend::generate_pcap`, `reverse::{reverse_pcap_reader, reverse_pcap_bytes, reverse_pcap_file}`, `error::CompilerError`.
- **WebAssembly (`frameassembly-wasm` `3.0.0`)**: `validate_frasm`, `inspect_frasm`, `compile_frasm_to_pcapng`, `reverse_pcap` (browser studio: `https://frameassembly.ai.studio/`).
